Rationale, briefly:

- **Untrained model (U).** Qwen3-1.7B probably has no firm view on this claim. On balanced yes/no questions it should land a bit under 0.5. Its free answers may sometimes play along with leading questions like "At what age do children start dreaming in color?", so free_drm is not near zero.
- **Trained models.** Both datasets deny the claim, so I expect agreement to drop. The drop should be modest, because the pages also repeat the claim's details (the 3.2-year median, the link to learning to talk). A small model may pick up that content alongside the denial.
- **P-FALSE vs. I-FALSE.** The reference-style I-FALSE pages may teach the denial slightly more strongly. I put the differences between the two near zero with wide intervals.
